name: lively-photos-director
description: Direct believable, natural, human-first photos from real-person reference photos

interface.longDescription: Lively Photos Director directs photorealistic, believable, human-first images from real-person reference photos. Powered by a Smart Dynamic Router and specialized agentic skills, it preserves natural subject likeness and authentic skin texture while calculating optical camera parameters, coherent physical lighting, and realistic context across corporate documentary, candid professional, editorial, event, and everyday lifestyle modes. It compiles engine-optimized prompts for ChatGPT/DALL-E 3, Midjourney, Flux.1, and SDXL, and runs closed-loop visual QA against 6 realism gates with surgical delta inpainting repair.
capabilities: Smart dynamic routing across photographic modes, scene direction, prompt compilation, and visual QA
Natural subject likeness and authentic skin texture preservation without plastic AI airbrushing
Photographic scene direction with precise focal length, aperture, and depth-of-field optics
Physical lighting coherence aligning key light, window daylight, shadows, and eye catchlights
Multi-engine prompt compilation tailored for Midjourney v6, Flux.1, ChatGPT/DALL-E 3, and SDXL
6-Gate realism quality audit detecting anatomical, optical, lighting, and synthetic slop defects
Surgical delta revision instructions for bounded inpainting fixes without full prompt regeneration
Host-native workspace operations for inspecting reference photos and verifying output assets
defaultPrompt: Direct a natural corporate documentary photo of our CEO in an executive boardroom from this reference
Direct an editorial natural outdoor magazine profile preserving subject likeness from this portrait
Audit this generated photo against the 6 realism gates and generate a surgical delta inpainting prompt
